content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD12345 -> service=redwood-hosted-inference latency_slo.p99 > 2.5s for 5m. region=eu-west. link: https://pd.example/PD12345 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: PD12345 triggered, initial policy: page oncall for infra-sre.
oncall_sre: acked PD12345 :hand: I'm on it. starting triage — checking dashboards & recent deploys.
jordan: metrics quick check: p95=420ms, p99=2.9s, error rate ~0.2%. spike started ~6280012200, concentrated on shard eu-west-2. KV cache evictions visible.
eng_lead_maria: any recent rollout or config changes in the last 20m? saw a batcher param PR merged earlier?
lee: we merged batch_throttle=0.7 @ 6279999000 for cost tuning, but that was canaried. no model push.
oncall_sre: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l region=eu-west -o wide` and `redis-cli info memory` now.

oncall_sre: logs show a lot of slow tail requests hitting larger-seq models, queue depth spikes on sidecars. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:32:20Z inference-sidecar[pid]: req_id=abcdef duration=2850ms seq_len=2048 model=gpt-15b
2026-03-15T10:32:22Z autoscaler: scale_inhibited=true reason=kv_hotkey_eviction
```

jordan: KV hotkeys + large seqs + aggressive batching threshold causing long queuing for tail requests. think it's queuing rather than pure compute.
eng_lead_maria: can we quickly route traffic away from eu-west pool or enable fallback to smaller model variant? we need to reduce customer impact.
oncall_sre: starting a manual traffic-reroute to dedicated fallback pool (dedicated-eu-fallback). running: `routerctl route add --svc=redwood-hosted-inference --region=eu-west --target=dedicated-eu-fallback --weight=0.3`
lee: also going to lower batch_throttle back to 0.5 in EU only via feature-flag. patching now.

oncall_sre: traffic reroute applied, 30% to fallback. monitoring...
jordan: within 90s p99 dropping from 2.9s -> 1.4s on fallback traffic, overall p99 -> 1.8s. good signal.
cs_emily: customer_prod_channel: no inbound tickets yet, but automated customer-health alerts showing minor degradation for 4 tenants. pinging CS on top accounts.
eng_lead_maria: good. hold the rollback of the batcher change until we confirm, but prefer safe defaults. can we throttle long-seq requests via request-size limiter?
lee: adding request-size limiter to 1.2k tokens for hosted path as temporary mitigation. patch applied.

oncall_sre: after limiter + reroute + batch rollback p99 is stable ~1.1s. continuing to monitor for 15m.
jordan: creating a short-lived dashboard panel and saving graph as snapshot: https://grafana/redwood/snapshot/abc123

pagerduty-bot: PD12345 acknowledged by oncall_sre at 6280012346. escalation suppressed.
eng_lead_maria: thanks everyone. @oncall_sre please prepare a short incident blurb for postmortem: root cause hypothesis (KV hotkey causing eviction -> queue imbalance + canary batcher param interacting poorly -> tail queuing). include timeline and mitigations.
oncall_sre: will do. rough timeline so far included in thread. planning to hand off to daytime rotation at 6280012600.
cs_emily: I'll update priority customer contacts and flag for follow-up once we have final impact numbers.
oncall_sre: PD12345 resolved (manual) at 6280012458 after p99 returned below SLO and traffic normalized. closing page.
incident-bot: PD12345 marked RESOLVED by oncall_sre. follow-up: create postmortem and link PD12345.
eng_lead_maria: excellent. add action items: durable hotkey mitigation, autoscaler tuning for queue backpressure, and tighter canary thresholds for batching. assign owners in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
oncall_sre: closing thread — will file postmortem and link here when ready. thank you all.
